name: Bunny's Mama Daikou Service
original_name: Bunny's ママ代行サービス
source:
The protagonist, [url=https://vndb.org/c122748]Hirose Ayato[/url], lost his mother when he was young.
Growing up without knowing motherly love, Ayato is interested in the "mother agency service" run by his neighbor [url=https://vndb.org/c122749]Rinko[/url].

Thinking that he might be able to experience a simulation of a mother and child, Ayato uses the service on a trial basis.
Rinko becomes Ayato's mom and spoils him even inside and outside of the service, the No. 1 mom in the store, [url=https://vndb.org/c122750]Kana[/url], his neighbor's mother, [url=https://vndb.org/c122751]Kiyoko[/url], and the newcomer, [url=https://vndb.org/c122752]Tsumugi[/url] join the fight as well.

A rich and strange mother-child life begins.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1213893&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
translation:
主人公[url=https://vndb.org/c122748]广濑彩人[/url]年幼丧母。
从未体会过母爱的彩人，对邻居[url=https://vndb.org/c122749]凛子[/url]经营的“妈妈代行服务”产生了兴趣。

抱着或许能体验一番模拟母子生活的想法，彩人试着预约了这项服务。
化身彩人妈妈的凛子无论在服务时间内外都对他百般宠溺，而店里的头牌妈妈[url=https://vndb.org/c122750]伽奈[/url]、邻居家的妈妈[url=https://vndb.org/c122751]清子[/url]，以及新人妈妈[url=https://vndb.org/c122752]紬贵[/url]也纷纷加入战局。

一段浓密而又奇妙的母子生活就此拉开帷幕。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1213893&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
